# Bid the plant, the system, and the extras.

> Bid a boiler changeout the way the trade does — plant, system, extras, and whether Saturday still pays — not a published special — and see the margin before you send the price.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
